# 1. Null model

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 5, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## | label: NS_All_Locus_AllReplicates
## | fig-cap: "SI 1.1.1. Single locus 30 replicates allele frequency dynamics for gradual two equal seasons selection model, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation."
## | fig-pos: "H"
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  # List to store data frames
  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Get parameters from the file name and read dataset
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    Gen <- as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H         = H,
        loci      = loci,
        SD        = SD,
        Gen       = Gen,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate),
        h2_sd     = paste0("h\u00B2 = ", H, " sd = ", SD),
        loci_gen  = paste0("loci = ", loci, " gen = ", Gen),
        loci_facet = paste0("Loci = ", loci)
      ) %>%
      mutate(loci_facet = factor(loci_facet, 
                                 levels = c("Loci = 1", "Loci = 10", "Loci = 70",
                                            "Loci = 100", "Loci = 300")))
    
    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}

########################################################################
######### Process the files to get combined data #####################
########################################################################

dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/NS.dir/"
pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n(1|10|300)_H0\\.(8)(SD(1|2|4))?(Gen(10|20|30))?\\.csv$"

combined_data <- process_files(dirpath, pattern)

# For each replicate (and loci group), randomly sample one position
# (Assuming the CSVs have a column named "Position")
set.seed(45696546)  # for reproducibility

sampled_data <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(replicate, loci) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
      unique_pos <- unique(.x$Position)
      # If there's only one unique position, retain it; otherwise, sample one
      selected_pos <- if(length(unique_pos) == 1) unique_pos else sample(unique_pos, 1)
      filter(.x, Position == selected_pos)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


########################################################################
######### Create the plot using the sampled data #####################
########################################################################

sampledreplc_AF <- sampled_data %>%
  mutate(
    H_SD_Gen = paste0("h\u00B2 = ", H, "\u0394\ = ", SD, " Gen = ", Gen)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Generation, y = Frequency, color = replicate)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = (replicate)),
            #color = (replicate), #"gray50", 
            alpha = 1,

  # stat_summary(fun = mean,

  #              geom = "line", 
  #              color = "red3", 
  #              alpha = 1, 
  #              size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ loci_facet, ncol = 3) +

    x = "Generation",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +

    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 35,

    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

## 1.2. Null selection phenotypes

```{r, echo=FALSE}
pheno_processing <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern, full.names = TRUE)
 
  data_list <- list()

  for(file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    herit <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate_id <- as.numeric(sub(".*MeanPhenotypes(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    
   data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    replicate  = as.factor(replicate_id),
    herit      = herit,  # ensure herit is numeric
    loci       = loci,   # ensure loci is numeric
    #loci_facet = paste0("Loci = ", loci, ": h\u00B2 = ", herit)
    loci_facet = paste0("Loci = ", loci)
      ) %>%
      mutate(loci_facet = factor(loci_facet, 
                                 levels = c("Loci = 1", "Loci = 10", "Loci = 70",
                                            "Loci = 100", "Loci = 300")))
    data_list[[file]] <- data
  }
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(data_list)

  
  # Create the plot using the chosen facet variable.
  p <- combined_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(Generation, Phenotype, color = replicate)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~loci_facet, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    mythemes
  
  return(list(combined_data = combined_data, plot = p))
}

```

## 1.3. Null selection spectral analysis

```{r, echo=FALSE}

run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  
  
  # Set a classic theme globally
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  # List files matching the pattern
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  
  # Create a data frame of file names and extract parameters
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1"   ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10"  ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70"  ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE       ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = as.numeric(n),
      H = as.numeric(H),
      # Use n here so the facet label matches your desired order
      param_combination = paste0("Loci = ", n, ": h\u00B2 = ", H)
    )
  
  # Set up the parallel backend using detected cores
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel.
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), 
                                .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        H = params$H,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        n = params$n,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, H, Genome, n, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list)
  
  filtered_data <- combined_data
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, replct, H, Genome, n, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects per grouping
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(Genome, replct, H, n, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)),
              .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density estimates in parallel
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), 
                            .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      n = params$n,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  
  # Combine plot data and filter based on a threshold
  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list) %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = 80) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    #mutate(loci_facet = paste0("Loci = ", n, ": h\u00B2 = ", H))
    mutate(loci_facet = paste0("Loci = ", n)) %>%
    mutate(loci_facet = factor(loci_facet,
                               levels = c("Loci = 1", "Loci = 10", "Loci = 70", 
                                          "Loci = 100", "Loci = 300")))
  

  fft_plots <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ loci_facet, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

```{r, fig.width = 40, fig.height = 15, echo=FALSE}
#| label: Ns_SpectralAnalysis_All_architectures
#| fig-cap: "SI 1.3. Spectral density across 30 replicates for all genetic architecture under Null selection model. The density plots do not show any peak as selection is purely driven by random drift."
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| 
dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/NS.dir/"
pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n(1|10|300)_H0\\.(8)(SD(1|2|4))?(Gen(10|20|30))?\\.csv$" 
result <- run_fft_analysis(dirpath, pattern, spectrum_span = 2)
Ns_SpectralAnalysis_All_architectures <- result

ggsave(filename = "SI_1.3.NS_SpectralAnalysis_All_architectures.jpg", Ns_SpectralAnalysis_All_architectures, path = "../OutputFigures.dir/SupplementalFigures.dir", width = 40, height = 15, units = "in", dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)

Ns_SpectralAnalysis_All_architectures
```

### 2.1.1. Monogenic

```{r, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 30, echo=FALSE}
#| label: CS_Single_Locus_AllReplicates
#| fig-cap: "SI 2.1.1. Single locus 30 replicates allele frequency dynamics for constant selection model, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation."
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| 
#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  

  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Extracting parameters
  
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H         = H,
        loci      = loci,
        SD        = SD,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate))

    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}

########################################################################
######### Process the files to get combined data and make a plot ######
#######################################################################

dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/CS.dir/"

  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 35,
                               hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15,
                               margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.line   = element_line(size = 2),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 40),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold",
                                margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold",
                                margin = margin(r = 10)),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
```

## 2.3. Spectral analysis for all parameters

```{r, echo=FALSE}
run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  # Create a data frame with filenames and extract parameters
  
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1" ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10" ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70" ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = as.numeric(n),
      H = as.numeric(H),
      SD = as.numeric(SD),
      Gen = as.numeric(Gen),
      param_combination = paste0("n_", n, "_H", H, 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("_SD", SD), ""), 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("_Gen", Gen), ""))
    )
  
  # Set up parallel backend
  
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        n = params$n,
        H = params$H,
        SD = params$SD,
        Gen = params$Gen,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, n, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list)

  filtered_data <- combined_data 
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density estimates in parallel
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      n = params$n,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      SD = params$SD,
      Gen = params$Gen,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  

  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list)
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = case_when(
      Gen == 10 ~ 40,
      Gen == 20 ~ 50,
      Gen == 30 ~ 80,
      TRUE ~ 80
    )) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Genome_Gen = paste0("Genome = ", Genome, " Gen = ", Gen),
      h2_sd = paste("H = ", H," ", "\u0394\ = ", SD, sep = ""), 
      #H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
      #SD_label = ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("SD = ", SD), "No SD"),
      Gen_label = ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("Gen = ", Gen), "No Gen"),
      n_label = paste0("n_", n)
    )
  
  fft_plots <- list()
  
  uni_genomegen <- unique(plot_data$Genome_Gen)
  
  for(genomegen in uni_genomegen){
    myplot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Genome_Gen == genomegen)

  fft_plots[[genomegen]] <- ggplot(myplot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ h2_sd, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  }
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

```{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 8, echo=FALSE}
pattern <- "^genome"
result <- run_fft_analysis(dirpath, pattern, spectrum_span = 2)

```

# 3. Long-term runs with mutation rate

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}

#| label: LongTermRunsWithMutatioRate_10Ne

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(future)
library(furrr)

###############################################################################
############################ Settings ##########################################
###############################################################################

base_dir <- "/home/etb68/Mylab/evogen-sims/FluctSelectionModels.dir/Output.dir/LongRuns.dir"

plot_dir <- "/home/etb68/Mylab/evogen-sims/FluctSelectionModels.dir/WritingFigures.dir/OutputFigures.dir/PolymorphismMaintenance_plt.dir"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

replicates <- 1:5

target_n   <- 100
target_H   <- c(0.1, 0.8)
target_SD  <- c(1, 4)
target_Gen <- c(10, 30)

n_workers <- 32
plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

required_cols <- c("Generation", "Position", "Effect", "Origin", "Frequency")

###############################################################################
############################ Model folders #####################################
###############################################################################

folders <- tibble::tribble(
  ~folder,            ~selection,  ~mutation,
  "NS_Mut_Ext.dir",   "Null",      "Mutation",
  "NS_Ext.dir",       "Null",      "No mutation",
  "FS_Mut_Ext.dir",   "Seasonal",  "Mutation",
  "FS_Ext.dir",       "Seasonal",  "No mutation"
)

###############################################################################
############################ File list #########################################
###############################################################################

seasonal_files <- expand_grid(
  replicate = replicates,
  n = target_n,
  H = target_H,
  SD = target_SD,
  Gen = target_Gen
) %>%
  crossing(folders %>% filter(selection == "Seasonal")) %>%
  mutate(
    filename = paste0(
      "genome", replicate,
      "_n", n,
      "_H", H,
      "SD", SD,
      "Gen", Gen,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

null_files <- expand_grid(
  replicate = replicates,
  n = target_n,
  H = target_H
) %>%
  crossing(folders %>% filter(selection == "Null")) %>%
  mutate(
    SD = NA_real_,
    Gen = NA_real_,
    filename = paste0(
      "genome", replicate,
      "_n", n,
      "_H", H,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

files <- bind_rows(seasonal_files, null_files) %>%
  mutate(
    file = file.path(base_dir, folder, filename)
  ) %>%
  filter(file.exists(file)) %>%
  select(
    file, filename, replicate, n, H, SD, Gen, selection, mutation
  )

if (nrow(files) == 0) {
  stop("No target files were found. Check base_dir and parameter values.")
}

###############################################################################
############################ Helper functions ##################################
###############################################################################

read_sim_file <- function(file) {
  
  df <- tryCatch(
    read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Failed to read: ", file, " (", conditionMessage(e), ")")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning(
      "Skipping ", file,
      " - missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Allele = paste(Position, Effect, Origin, sep = "_"),
      fixed_here = !is.na(Frequency) & Frequency == 1,
      lost_here = !is.na(Frequency) & Frequency == 0,
      segregating_here = !is.na(Frequency) & Frequency > 0 & Frequency < 1
    )
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}

###############################################################################
############################ Main calculation ##################################
###############################################################################

calculate_metrics <- function(file, info) {
  
  df <- read_sim_file(file)
  
  if (is.null(df)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  generations <- sort(unique(df$Generation))
  first_generation <- min(generations)
  max_generation <- max(generations)
  
  first_cohort <- df %>%
    filter(Generation == first_generation, segregating_here) %>%
    distinct(Allele) %>%
    pull(Allele)
  
  if (length(first_cohort) == 0) {
    warning("No segregating first-cohort QTLs found in: ", file)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  first_cohort_fates <- df %>%
    filter(Allele %in% first_cohort) %>%
    group_by(Allele) %>%
    summarise(
      last_seen = max(Generation),
      
      first_fixed = if (any(fixed_here)) {
        min(Generation[fixed_here])
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      first_zero = if (any(lost_here)) {
        min(Generation[lost_here])
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      inferred_loss = if (
        is.na(first_fixed) &&
        last_seen < max_generation
      ) {
        generations[generations > last_seen][1]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      
      first_lost = {
        losses <- c(first_zero, inferred_loss)
        losses <- losses[!is.na(losses)]
        if (length(losses) == 0) NA_real_ else min(losses)
      },
      
      absorbed_generation = {
        fates <- c(first_fixed, first_lost)
        fates <- fates[!is.na(fates)]
        if (length(fates) == 0) NA_real_ else min(fates)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  total_first_cohort <- n_distinct(first_cohort_fates$Allele)
  
  first_cohort_metrics <- tibble(Generation = generations) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      first_cohort_fixed_or_lost = sum(
        !is.na(first_cohort_fates$absorbed_generation) &
          first_cohort_fates$absorbed_generation <= Generation
      ),
      
      first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate =
        first_cohort_fixed_or_lost / total_first_cohort
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(Generation) %>%
    mutate(
      first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate =
        cummax(first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate)
    )
  
  segregating_metrics <- df %>%
    group_by(Generation) %>%
    summarise(
      segregating_qtl_alleles = n_distinct(Allele[segregating_here]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  first_cohort_metrics %>%
    left_join(segregating_metrics, by = "Generation") %>%
    mutate(
      segregating_qtl_alleles = replace_na(segregating_qtl_alleles, 0L),
      filename = info$filename,
      replicate = info$replicate,
      n = info$n,
      H = info$H,
      SD = info$SD,
      Gen = info$Gen,
      selection = info$selection,
      mutation = info$mutation
    )
}

###############################################################################
############################ Run analysis ######################################
###############################################################################

qtl_metrics <- files %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  split(.$row_id) %>%
  future_map_dfr(
    function(info) {
      calculate_metrics(
        file = info$file,
        info = info
      )
    },
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )

plan(sequential)

if (nrow(qtl_metrics) == 0) {
  stop("No QTL metrics were returned.")
}

###############################################################################
############################ Duplicate null for facets #########################
###############################################################################

sdgen_grid <- expand_grid(
  SD = target_SD,
  Gen = target_Gen
)

qtl_disp <- bind_rows(
  qtl_metrics %>%
    filter(selection == "Seasonal"),
  
  qtl_metrics %>%
    filter(selection == "Null") %>%
    select(-SD, -Gen) %>%
    crossing(sdgen_grid)
)

###############################################################################
############################ Labels ############################################
###############################################################################

qtl_disp <- qtl_disp %>%
  mutate(
    model = case_when(
      selection == "Null" & mutation == "No mutation" ~ "Null + no mutation",
      selection == "Null" & mutation == "Mutation" ~ "Null + mutation",
      selection == "Seasonal" & mutation == "No mutation" ~ "Seasonal + no mutation",
      selection == "Seasonal" & mutation == "Mutation" ~ "Seasonal + mutation"
    ),
    
    model = factor(
      model,
      levels = c(
        "Null + mutation",
        "Null + no mutation",
        "Seasonal + mutation",
        "Seasonal + no mutation"
      )
    ),
    
    H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
    param_label = paste0("\u0394 = ", SD, ": Gen = ", Gen),
    replicate_label = paste0("Replicate = ", replicate)
  )

###############################################################################
############################ Mean across replicates ############################
###############################################################################

qtl_mean <- qtl_disp %>%
  group_by(
    Generation,
    H, SD, Gen,
    H_label, param_label,
    selection, mutation, model
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate =
      safe_mean(first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate),
    
    mean_segregating_qtl_alleles =
      safe_mean(segregating_qtl_alleles),
    
    n_replicates =
      sum(is.finite(first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate)),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(mean_first_cohort_fixation_loss_rate),
    is.finite(mean_segregating_qtl_alleles)
  )

###############################################################################
############################ Theme #############################################
###############################################################################

theme_qtl <- theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.9, "lines")
  )

```

### 3.1. The cumulative fixation/loss rate of the initial QTL with and without recurrent mutation

```{r, fig.width=20, fig.height=10, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: IntialQTLs_MeanFixationRate_AcrossReplicate_ByReplicate
#| fig-cap: "SI 3.1. The cumulative fixation/loss rate of the initial QTL (new mutation excluded) comparison for null and instantaneous fluctuating selection models for a polygenic trait of 100 loci, with and without recurrent mutation, across parameter combinations. The top panel shows the average across 5 replicates, while the bottom panel shows the rate per replicate. In some low-heritability parameter combinations, fluctuating selection seems to exhibit a lower fixation rate than the null model during earlier generations (< 50,000 generations); however, this pattern is not consistent across all parameter combinations, and trajectories converge later in the simulation."
#| fig-pos: "H"

) +

initial_QTL_fixation_loss_rate_by_replicate
```

### 4.1.1. Monogenic

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 30, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: Single_Locus_AllReplicates
#| fig-cap: "SI 4.1.1. Single locus (30 replicates) allele frequency dynamics for instantaneous selection, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation across replicates."
#| fig-pos: "H"

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  

  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Extracting parameters
  
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    Gen <- as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H         = H,
        loci      = loci,
        SD        = SD,
        Gen       = Gen,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate),
        h2_sd     = paste0("h2 = ", H, " sd = ", SD),
        loci_gen  = paste0("loci = ", loci, " gen = ", Gen)
      )
    
    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}

########################################################################
######### Process the files to get combined data and make a plot ######
#######################################################################

dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/LinFS.dir/"
pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n(1)_H0\\.(1|5|8)(SD(1|2|4))?(Gen(10|20|30))?\\.csv$"

combined_data <- process_files(dirpath, pattern)

SingleLocusAF <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    H_SD_Gen = paste0("h\u00B2 = ", H, "\u0394\ = ", SD, " Gen = ", Gen)
  ) %>%

  geom_line(aes(group = replicate),
            color = "gray50",

  # geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5,

  #            alpha = 0.5, 
  #            size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               aes(group = 1), 
               geom = "line", 
               color = "red4", 
               alpha = 1, 
               size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ H_SD_Gen, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",

  ) +

    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
```

## 4.2. Spectral analysis for all parameters

```{r, echo=FALSE}
run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  
   mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  # File list
  
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with filenames and extract parameters
  
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      # base_name = basename(file_name),
      # replct = str_extract(base_name, "genome\\d+"),
      # n = str_extract(base_name, "_n\\d+") %>% str_remove("_n"),
      # H = str_extract(base_name, "_H\\d+\\.\\d*") %>% str_remove("_H"),
      # SD = str_extract(base_name, "SD\\d+(\\.\\d+)?"),
      # SD = ifelse(is.na(SD), NA, str_remove(SD, "SD")),
      # Gen = str_extract(base_name, "Gen\\d+"),
      # Gen = ifelse(is.na(Gen), NA, str_remove(Gen, "Gen")),
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1" ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10" ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70" ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
     mutate(
      param_combination = paste0("n_", n, "_H", H, 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("_SD", SD), ""), 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("_Gen", Gen), ""))
    )
  
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        n = params$n,
        H = params$H,
        SD = params$SD,
        Gen = params$Gen,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, n, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list)

  filtered_data <- combined_data 
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density 
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      n = params$n,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      SD = params$SD,
      Gen = params$Gen,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  

  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list)
  

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = case_when(
      Gen == 10 ~ 40,
      Gen == 20 ~ 50,
      Gen == 30 ~ 80,
      TRUE ~ 80
    )) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Genome_Gen = paste0("Genome = ", Genome, " Gen = ", Gen),
      h2_sd = paste("H = ", H," ", "\u0394\ = ", SD, sep = ""), 
      #H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
      #SD_label = ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("SD = ", SD), "No SD"),
      Gen_label = ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("Gen = ", Gen), "No Gen"),
      n_label = paste0("n_", n)
    )
  
  fft_plots <- list()
  
  uni_genomegen <- unique(plot_data$Genome_Gen)
  
  for(genomegen in uni_genomegen){
    myplot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Genome_Gen == genomegen)
    
  fft_plots[[genomegen]] <- ggplot(myplot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ h2_sd, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  }
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

# 5. Fixed percentages for each architecture

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10, echo=FALSE, dpi = 1200, message=FALSE}
#| label: Fixation_Percentages
#| fig-cap: "SI 5. Percentage of fixed loci across different genetic architectures based on parameter interactions from instantaneous selection model. The single locus trait exhibits the highest percentage of fixed loci among the 30 replicates, followed by the 10 loci model, while 70 loci or more shows a consistent fixation rate."
#| fig-pos: "H"
#### Parameter combination as colors
library(furrr)
library(fs)
#library(stringr)
library(dplyr)

path <- "../../Output.dir/LinFS.dir/"
pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n\\d+_H0.(1|5|8)(SD[1|4])?Gen(10|30)?\\.csv$" 

# List files using list.files (full paths, filtering by regex)
files <- list.files(path, pattern, full.names = TRUE)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No files found matching the pattern in the specified path.")
}

available_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
workers_to_use <- max(1, available_cores - 4)  
plan(multicore, workers = workers_to_use)

process_file <- function(file) {
  filename <- path_file(file)
  repl_val <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", basename(filename)))
  H_val <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", basename(filename)))
  loci_val <- as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", basename(filename)))
  SD_val <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", basename(filename)))
  Gen_val <- as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", basename(filename)))
  
  df <- read.csv(file) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of("Origin")) %>%
    mutate(
      Position = as_factor(Position),
      repl = (repl_val),
      H    = (H_val),
      loci = (loci_val),
      SD   = (SD_val),
      Gen  = (Gen_val)
    )
  
  required <- c("H", "loci", "SD", "Gen", "repl", "Position")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning("File ", filename, " is missing the following columns: ",
            paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  return(df)
}

combined_data <- future_map_dfr(files, process_file, .options = furrr_options(chunk_size = 100))

data_with_fix <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(H, loci, SD, Gen, repl, Position) %>%
  filter(Frequency == 1 | (Frequency < 1 & Generation == max(Generation) & max(Generation) < 2000)) %>% 
  distinct(H, loci, SD, Gen, repl, Position) %>% 
  ungroup()

replicate_summary <- data_with_fix %>%
  group_by(H, loci, SD, Gen, repl) %>%
  summarise(
    fixed_count = n_distinct(Position),
    total_count = 30 * loci,  # count of unique loci in this replicate
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


parameter_summary <- replicate_summary %>%
  group_by(H, loci, SD, Gen, total_count) %>%
  summarise(
    total_fixed    = sum(fixed_count),
    total_possible = total_count,
    Perc_Loci      = total_fixed * 100 / total_possible,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gen_SD  = paste0("Gen = ", Gen, " SD = ", SD),
    H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
    Combo   = paste0(H_label, ", ", Gen_SD)
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

Fixation_Percentages <-
  ggplot(
    parameter_summary %>%
      mutate(
        H   = as_factor(H),
        loci= as_factor(loci),
        SD  = as_factor(SD),

      ),
    aes(
      x = loci,
      y = Perc_Loci,

    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 3) +
  geom_point(size = 7, stroke = 0) +

    x = "Number of Loci",

    color = "Heritability (h\u00B2)",

  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue", "gray50", "firebrick")) +
```

# 6. Sampling Points for spectral analysis

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 10, echo=FALSE}
#| label: SamplingPointSpecAnalysis
#| fig-cap: "SI 6. Spectral analysis of instantaneous selection for a 100 loci model using 10 sampling points to compare the identification of spectral peaks under high versus low parameter combinations. Although seasonal signatures of selection can be identified with 10 samples under the high parameter combination, recovering the spectral peak remains challenging under the low parameter combination, which may require increasing the number of sampling points."
#| fig-pos: "H"
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)


###############################################################################
#################### Defining files, number of sequence and the spans#######
###############################################################################

dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/LinFS.dir/"
my_pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n100_H0\\.(1|8)SD(1|4)Gen(10|30)\\.csv$"

# Number of sampled time points after the first generation
nseq <- 10

# Spectral smoothing span
spectrum_span <- 2

###############################################################################
########################## Extracting parameters ##############################
###############################################################################

parse_simulation_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  file_list <- list.files(
    path = dirpath,
    pattern = pattern,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  

  files_df <- tibble(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),
      
      replicate = ifelse(
        grepl("genome\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      
      n = ifelse(
        grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      
      H = ifelse(
        grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
      ),
      
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      parameter_label = case_when(
        H == 0.1 & SD == 1 & Gen == 10 ~ "h² = 0.1 Δ = 1 Gen=10",
        H == 0.8 & SD == 4 & Gen == 30 ~ "h² = 0.8 Δ = 4 Gen=30",
        TRUE ~ paste0("h² = ", H, " Δ = ", SD, " Gen=", Gen)
      )
    )
  
  files_df
}

###############################################################################
########################## Function for spectral analysis######################
###############################################################################

run_fft_one_file <- function(
    file_name,
    replicate,
    H,
    SD,
    Gen,
    parameter_label,
    nseq = 10,
    spectrum_span = 2
) {
  
  full_df <- utils::read.csv(file_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  interval <- Gen
  
  #first_generation <- min(full_df$Generation, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Sampling 1: first generation + first nseq end samples ########
  #########################################################################
  
  end_generations <- c(
    #first_generation,
    seq(
      from = interval,
      by = interval,
      length.out = nseq
    )
  ) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  gens_end <- full_df %>%
    filter(Generation %in% end_generations) %>%
    mutate(
      allele_id = as.factor(Position),
      sampling_scheme = "End",
      sampling_interval = interval
    )
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Sampling 2: first generation + first nseq mid/end samples ####
  #########################################################################
  
  mid_end_generations <- c(
   # first_generation,
    seq(
      from = interval / 2,
      by = interval / 2,
      length.out = nseq
    )
  ) %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  gens_mid_end <- full_df %>%
    filter(Generation %in% mid_end_generations) %>%
    mutate(
      allele_id = as.factor(Position),
      sampling_scheme = "Mid & End",
      sampling_interval = interval / 2
    )
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Combine sampled data ###############################################
  #########################################################################
  
  sampled_data <- bind_rows(
    gens_end,
    gens_mid_end
  )
  
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Mean allele frequency per sampled generation #######################
  #########################################################################
  
  mean_allele_data <- sampled_data %>%
    group_by(sampling_scheme, sampling_interval, Generation) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_allele_frequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(sampling_scheme, Generation)
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Computing the spectral density ######################################
  #########################################################################
  
  spectrum_data <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(sampling_scheme, sampling_interval) %>%
    summarize(
      n_timepoints = n(),
      sampled_generations = list(Generation),
      ts_data = list(stats::ts(mean_allele_frequency, frequency = 1)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_timepoints >= 4) %>%
    mutate(
      spec_result = map(
        ts_data,
        ~ stats::spectrum(
          .x,
          spans = spectrum_span,
          plot = FALSE
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      spectrum_tbl = map2(
        spec_result,
        sampling_interval,
        ~ tibble(
          Period_sample_units = 1 / .x$freq,
          
          # Convert period from sampled observations to real generations
          Period = (1 / .x$freq) * .y,
          
          Spectrum = as.numeric(.x$spec)
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      sampling_scheme,
      sampling_interval,
      n_timepoints,
      sampled_generations,
      spectrum_tbl
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(spectrum_tbl) %>%
    mutate(
      replicate = replicate,
      H = H,
      SD = SD,
      Gen = Gen,
      parameter_label = parameter_label,
      file = basename(file_name)
    )
  
  spectrum_data
}

###############################################################################
########################## Low/High Multiple-File FFT ####################
###############################################################################

run_fft_low_high_multiple_files <- function(
    dirpath,
    pattern,
    nseq = 10,
    spectrum_span = 2,
    show_legend = FALSE
) {
  
  files_df <- parse_simulation_files(
    dirpath = dirpath,
    pattern = pattern
  )
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Keep only high and low combinations #############################
  #########################################################################
  
  files_df <- files_df %>%
    filter(
      (H == 0.1 & SD == 1 & Gen == 10) |
        (H == 0.8 & SD == 4 & Gen == 30)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      parameter_label = case_when(
        H == 0.1 & SD == 1 & Gen == 10 ~ "h² = 0.1 Δ = 1 Gen=10",
        H == 0.8 & SD == 4 & Gen == 30 ~ "h² = 0.8 Δ = 4 Gen=30"
      ),
      parameter_label = factor(
        parameter_label,
        levels = c(
          "h² = 0.1 Δ = 1 Gen=10",
          "h² = 0.8 Δ = 4 Gen=30"
        )
      )
    )
  
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Apply FFT to each replicate/file ###################################
  #########################################################################
  
  plot_data <- pmap_dfr(
    list(
      file_name = files_df$file_name,
      replicate = files_df$replicate,
      H = files_df$H,
      SD = files_df$SD,
      Gen = files_df$Gen,
      parameter_label = files_df$parameter_label
    ),
    function(file_name, replicate, H, SD, Gen, parameter_label) {
      run_fft_one_file(
        file_name = file_name,
        replicate = replicate,
        H = H,
        SD = SD,
        Gen = Gen,
        parameter_label = parameter_label,
        nseq = nseq,
        spectrum_span = spectrum_span
      )
    }
  )
  
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Clean labels and enforce order #####################################
  #########################################################################
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      replicate = factor(replicate),
      sampling_scheme = factor(
        sampling_scheme,
        levels = c("End", "Mid & End")
      ),
      parameter_label = factor(
        parameter_label,
        levels = c(
          "h² = 0.1 Δ = 1 Gen=10",
          "h² = 0.8 Δ = 4 Gen=30"
        )
      )
    )
  
  #########################################################################
  #### The sampling includes the very first generation #############################
  #########################################################################
  # With the first generation included, the time series has one extra point,
  # but the regular sampling interval used for period conversion remains:
  #
  # End:       Gen
  # Mid & End: Gen / 2
  
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      period_min = case_when(
        sampling_scheme == "End" ~ 1, #2 * Gen,
        sampling_scheme == "Mid & End" ~ 1, #~ Gen,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      period_max = case_when(
        sampling_scheme == "End" ~ 5 * Gen,
        sampling_scheme == "Mid & End" ~ 5 * Gen,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      Period >= period_min,
      Period <= period_max
    )

  #########################################################################
  #### Split into End and Mid & End #######################################
  #########################################################################
  
  plot_data_end <- plot_data %>%
    filter(sampling_scheme == "End")
  
  plot_data_mid_end <- plot_data %>%
    filter(sampling_scheme == "Mid & End")
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Common theme #######################################################
  #########################################################################
  
  theme_spectral <- theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      
      legend.position = ifelse(show_legend, "right", "none"),
      
      axis.text = element_text(
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        margin = margin(t = 16),
        size = 20,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = 18),
        size = 20,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      
      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 2.2
      ),
      
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 15,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.01,
        face = "bold",
        size = 34
      ),
      
      legend.title = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 12
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(2.2, "lines")
    )
  
  #########################################################################
  #### A) End plot ########################################################
  #########################################################################
  
  p_end <- ggplot(
    plot_data_end,
    aes(
      x = Period,
      y = Spectrum,
      color = replicate,
      group = replicate
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
   # geom_point()+
    facet_wrap(
      ~ parameter_label,
      scales = "free",
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "A) Spectral Density: Sampling at the end of each season",
      x = "Period (Generations)",
      y = "Spectral Density",
      color = "Replicate"
    ) +
    theme_spectral
  
  #########################################################################
  #### B) Mid & End plot ##################################################
  #########################################################################
  
  p_mid_end <- ggplot(
    plot_data_mid_end,
    aes(
      x = Period,
      y = Spectrum,
      color = replicate,
      group = replicate
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
     #geom_point()+ 
    facet_wrap(
      ~ parameter_label,
      scales = "free",
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number()
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "B) Spectral Density: Sampling at the middle & end of each season",
      x = "Period (Generations)",
      y = "Spectral Density",
      color = "Replicate"
    ) +
    theme_spectral
  
  #########################################################################
  #### Combine with patchwork #############################################
  #########################################################################
  
  final_plot <- p_end / p_mid_end
  
  #return(final_plot)
  
  return(list(plot_data_end =plot_data_end, plot_data_mid_end = plot_data_mid_end, final_plot = final_plot))
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 40, fig.height = 55, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: GradI_Single_Locus_AllReplicates
#| fig-cap: "SI 7.1.1. Single locus 30 replicates allele frequency dynamics for gradual two equal seasons selection model, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation."
#| fig-pos: "H"

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Extracting parameters
  
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    Gen <- as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H         = H,
        loci      = loci,
        SD        = SD,
        Gen       = Gen,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate),
        h2_sd     = paste0("h2 = ", H, " sd = ", SD),
        loci_gen  = paste0("loci = ", loci, " gen = ", Gen)
      )
    
    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}

######### Process the files to get combined data and make a plot ######
```

## 7.2. Spectral analysis for all parameters

```{r, echo=FALSE}
run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  
  
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  # File list
  
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with filenames and extract parameters
  
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1" ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10" ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70" ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = as.numeric(n),
      H = as.numeric(H),
      SD = as.numeric(SD),
      Gen = as.numeric(Gen),
      param_combination = paste0("n_", n, "_H", H, 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("_SD", SD), ""), 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("_Gen", Gen), ""))
    )
  
  # Set up parallel backend
  
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        n = params$n,
        H = params$H,
        SD = params$SD,
        Gen = params$Gen,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, n, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list)

  filtered_data <- combined_data 
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density estimates in parallel
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      n = params$n,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      SD = params$SD,
      Gen = params$Gen,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  

  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list)
  

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = case_when(
      Gen == 10 ~ 40,
      Gen == 20 ~ 50,
      Gen == 30 ~ 80,
      TRUE ~ 80
    )) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Genome_Gen = paste0("Genome = ", Genome, " Gen = ", Gen),
      h2_sd = paste("H = ", H," ", "\u0394\ = ", SD, sep = ""), 
      #H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
      #SD_label = ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("SD = ", SD), "No SD"),
      Gen_label = ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("Gen = ", Gen), "No Gen"),
      n_label = paste0("n_", n)
    )
  
  fft_plots <- list()
  
  uni_genomegen <- unique(plot_data$Genome_Gen)
  
  for(genomegen in uni_genomegen){
    myplot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Genome_Gen == genomegen)

  fft_plots[[genomegen]] <- ggplot(myplot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ h2_sd, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  }
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

```{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 8, echo=FALSE}
gradIplots_SPA <- run_fft_analysis(dirpath, pattern, spectrum_span = 2)
```

### 8.1.1. Monogenic

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 20, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: GradII_Single_Locus_AllReplicates
#| fig-cap: "SI 8.1.1. Single locus 30 replicates allele frequency dynamics for gradual optima change with even optima and uneven season length, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation."
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| 
#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  

  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Extracting parameters
  
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H  = H,
        loci = loci,
        SD = SD,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate))

    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}

########################################################################
######### Process the files to get combined data and make a plot ######
#######################################################################

dirpath <- "../../Output.dir/SinFSGen.dir/"
pattern <- "^genome\\d+_n(1)_H0\\.(1|5|8)(SD(1|2|4))?(Gen(10|20|30))?\\.csv$"

combined_data <- process_files(dirpath, pattern)

GradII_SingleLocusAF <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    h2_sd = paste0("SD = ", SD, ": ",  "h\u00B2 = ", H)
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Generation, y = Frequency)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = replicate),
            color = "gray50", 
            alpha = 0.8, 
            size = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               aes(group = 1), 
               geom = "line", 
               color = "red3", 
               alpha = 1, 
               size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ h2_sd, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 35,
                               hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15,
                               margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.line   = element_line(size = 2),
    plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 40),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold",
                                margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold",
                                margin = margin(r = 10)),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(5, "lines"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

GradII_SingleLocusAF
```

## 8.2. Spectral analysis for all parameters

```{r, echo=FALSE}
run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  
  
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line       = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin     = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing   = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    )
  
  # File list
  
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with filenames and extract parameters
  
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1" ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10" ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70" ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = as.numeric(n),
      H = as.numeric(H),
      SD = as.numeric(SD),
      Gen = as.numeric(Gen),
      param_combination = paste0("n_", n, "_H", H, 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("_SD", SD), ""), 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("_Gen", Gen), ""))
    )
  
  # Set up parallel backend
  
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        n = params$n,
        H = params$H,
        SD = params$SD,
        Gen = params$Gen,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, n, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list) %>% filter(generation <=1802)

  filtered_data <- combined_data 
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density estimates in parallel
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      n = params$n,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      SD = params$SD,
      Gen = params$Gen,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  

  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list)
  

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = case_when(
      Gen == 10 ~ 40,
      Gen == 20 ~ 50,
      Gen == 30 ~ 80,
      TRUE ~ 80
    )) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Genome_Gen = paste0("Genome = ", Genome, " Gen = ", Gen),
      h2_sd = paste("H = ", H," ", "\u0394\ = ", SD, sep = ""), 
      #H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
      #SD_label = ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("SD = ", SD), "No SD"),
      Gen_label = ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("Gen = ", Gen), "No Gen"),
      n_label = paste0("n_", n)
    )
  
  fft_plots <- list()
  
  uni_genomegen <- unique(plot_data$Genome_Gen)
  
  for(genomegen in uni_genomegen){
    myplot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Genome_Gen == genomegen)

  fft_plots[[genomegen]] <- ggplot(myplot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ h2_sd, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  }
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 40, fig.height = 15, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: GradII_Uneq_Single_Locus_AllReplicates
#| fig-cap: "SI 9.1.1. Single locus 30 replicates allele frequency dynamics for gradual optima change with uneven optima and uneven season length, showing all parameter interactions. The highlighted line indicates the mean allele frequency for each generation."

#####################################################
######### data processing function ##################
#####################################################

process_files <- function(dirpath, pattern) {
  
  files <- list.files(dirpath, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  

  dataframes <- list()
  
  # Extracting parameters
  
  for (file in files) {
    fname <- basename(file) 
    H <- as.numeric(sub(".*_H(0\\.\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    loci <- as.numeric( sub(".*_n(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    SD <- as.numeric(sub(".*SD(\\d+).*", "\\1", fname))
    replicate <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", fname))
    
    
    data <- read.csv(file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      mutate(
        H = H,
        loci = loci,
        SD = SD,
        replicate = as.factor(replicate))

    dataframes[[fname]] <- data
  }
  
  # Combine all dataframes into one 
  
  combined_data <- bind_rows(dataframes)
  
  return(combined_data)
}
```
