## 9.2. Spectral analysis for all parameters

```{r, echo=FALSE}
run_fft_analysis <- function(folder_path, pattern, spectrum_span = 2) {
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
  library(foreach)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(cowplot)
  
  
  theme_set(theme_classic())
  
  mythemes <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"), 
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 25, 
                                       margin = margin(t = 20), hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 40, angle = 15, 
                                       margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.line = element_line(size = 3),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.01, face = "bold", size = 80, 
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "lines")),
      plot.margin = unit(c(5, 1, 1, 1), "lines"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 30)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 35)),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(5, "lines"),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  
  # File list
  
  file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(file_list) == 0) {
    stop("No files found with the given pattern.")
  }
  
  # Create a data frame with filenames and extract parameters
  
  files_df <- data.frame(file_name = file_list) %>%
    mutate(
      base_name = basename(file_name),  
      n = ifelse(
         grepl("_n\\d+", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_n(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
           ),
      replct <- as.numeric(sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", base_name)),
      H = ifelse(
         grepl("_H[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*", base_name),
         as.numeric(sub(".*_H([0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*).*", "\\1", base_name)),
         NA_real_
        ),
      SD = ifelse(
        grepl("SD[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Gen = ifelse(
        grepl("Gen\\d+", base_name),
        as.numeric(sub(".*Gen(\\d+).*", "\\1", base_name)),
        NA_real_
        ),
      Genome = case_when(
        n == "1" ~ "Monogenic",
        n == "10" ~ "Oligogenic",
        n == "70" ~ "Polygenic 70",
        n == "100" ~ "Polygenic 100",
        n == "300" ~ "Polygenic 300",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n = as.numeric(n),
      H = as.numeric(H),
      SD = as.numeric(SD),
      Gen = as.numeric(Gen),
      param_combination = paste0("n_", n, "_H", H, 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("_SD", SD), ""), 
                                 ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("_Gen", Gen), ""))
    )
  
  # Set up parallel backend
  
  num_cores <- detectCores()
  cl <- makeCluster(64)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
  
  # Read and combine data from all replicate files in parallel
  combined_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(files_df$file_name), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    file <- files_df$file_name[i]
    params <- files_df[i, ]
    df <- read.csv(file)
    data <- df %>%
      mutate(
        allele_id = as.factor(Position),
        generation = as.numeric(Generation),
        allele_frequency = Frequency,
        file = params$base_name,
        replct = params$replct,
        n = params$n,
        H = params$H,
        SD = params$SD,
        Gen = params$Gen,
        Genome = params$Genome,
        param_combination = params$param_combination
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(allele_id, generation, allele_frequency, replct, n, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination)
    data
  }
  combined_data <- bind_rows(combined_data_list) %>% filter(generation <=1802)

  filtered_data <- combined_data 
  
  # Calculating the mean allele frequency for each grouping
  mean_allele_data <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(generation, n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(mean_allele_frequency = mean(allele_frequency), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Creating time series objects
  ts_data_list <- mean_allele_data %>%
    group_by(n, replct, H, SD, Gen, Genome, param_combination) %>%
    summarize(ts_data = list(ts(mean_allele_frequency, start = min(generation), frequency = 1)), .groups = 'drop')
  
  # Computing spectral density estimates in parallel
  spec_results_list <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(ts_data_list), .packages = c("stats")) %dopar% {
    ts_data <- ts_data_list$ts_data[[i]]
    spectrum(ts_data, spans = spectrum_span, plot = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Preparing data for plotting
  plot_data_list <- foreach(i = seq_along(spec_results_list), .packages = c("dplyr")) %dopar% {
    spec_result <- spec_results_list[[i]]
    params <- ts_data_list[i, ]
    period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
    data.frame(
      Period = period,
      Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
      n = params$n,
      replct = params$replct,
      H = params$H,
      SD = params$SD,
      Gen = params$Gen,
      Genome = params$Genome,
      param_combination = params$param_combination
    )
  }
  
  stopCluster(cl)
  

  plot_data <- bind_rows(plot_data_list)
  

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(param_combination) %>%
    mutate(threshold = case_when(
      Gen == 10 ~ 40,
      Gen == 20 ~ 50,
      Gen == 30 ~ 80,
      TRUE ~ 80
    )) %>%
    filter(Period < threshold) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Genome_Gen = paste0("Genome = ", Genome, " Gen = ", Gen),
      h2_sd = paste("H = ", H," ", "\u0394\ = ", SD, sep = ""), 
      #H_label = paste0("H = ", H),
      #SD_label = ifelse(!is.na(SD), paste0("SD = ", SD), "No SD"),
      Gen_label = ifelse(!is.na(Gen), paste0("Gen = ", Gen), "No Gen"),
      n_label = paste0("n_", n)
    )
  
  fft_plots <- list()
  
  uni_genomegen <- unique(plot_data$Genome_Gen)
  
  for(genomegen in uni_genomegen){
    myplot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(Genome_Gen == genomegen)

  fft_plots[[genomegen]] <- ggplot(myplot_data, aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, color = factor(replct), group = factor(replct))) +
    geom_line(size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ h2_sd, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "Period (Generations)", y = "Spectral Density") +
    mythemes
  }
  
  return(fft_plots)
}

```

## 10. Spectral All models comparisons


```{r,  warning=FALSE, fig.width = 50, fig.height = 30, dpi=300, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: All_models_Spec
#| fig-cap: "SI 10. Spectral analysis across 30 replicates for monogenic(left), oligogenic(middle), and polygenic(right) traits, with each colored is one replicate. For the simple gradual model, the parameters are h2 = 0.5, Δ = 2, and Gen = 20. Thus, the dominant spectral peaks occur at 40, consistent with a full seasonal cycle. Although the oligogenic model has more noise, the complex gradual model I (uneven season lengths and even distance to optima Δ) exhibit four distinct peaks aligned with the four-season lengths, plus a faded long period peak at 60 which signal the recurrence across multiple cycles. In complex gradual II (uneven season lengths and uneven Δ), the spectrum is noisier than other selection regimes, and it is challenging to observe all peaks corresponding to the number of considered seasons mainly because some seasons have a small selection pressure and the dynamics in those seasons are masked by the presence of seasons experiencing stronger selections."
#| fig-pos: "H"
n_values <- c(1, 10,100)#1, 
gene_number_labels <- c("1" = "1 Locus", "10" = "10 Loci", "100" = "100 Loci", "300" = "300 Loci")

selections <- list(
#"LinFS.dir" = "Instantaneous",
"SinFS.dir" = "Simple Gradual",
"SinFSGen.dir" = "Complex Gradual I", 
"FourSeasFourAmp.dir" = "Complex Gradual II"
)

allele_freq_list <- list()
for (n in n_values) {
  for (dir_name in names(selections)) {
    selection_label <- selections[[dir_name]]
    if (dir_name == "SinFSGen.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD2\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    }else if (dir_name == "FourSeasFourAmp.dir") {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    } else {
      file_pattern <- paste0("genome\\d+_n", n, "_H0\\.5SD2Gen20\\.csv$")
      file_path <- paste0("../../Output.dir/", dir_name)
    }
    
    file_list <- list.files(
      path = file_path,
      pattern = file_pattern,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
    
    for (file in file_list) {
      data <- read.csv(file) #%>% filter(Generation >=1800)
      replicate_value <- as.numeric( sub(".*genome(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", basename(file)))
      
      data <- data %>%
        mutate(
          Selection = selection_label,
          Gene_Number = gene_number_labels[as.character(n)],
          Replicate = factor(replicate_value)
        )
      
      allele_freq_list[[length(allele_freq_list) + 1]] <- data
    }
  }
}

AlleleFreq_dataset <- bind_rows(allele_freq_list) %>%
  mutate(
    Selection = fct_relevel(Selection, "Instantaneous", "Simple Gradual", "Complex Gradual I", "Complex Gradual II"),
    Gene_Number = fct_relevel(Gene_Number, "1 Locus", "10 Loci", "100 Loci", "300 Loci")
  )

  num_cores_to_use <- min(detectCores() - 16, 8) # check the cores before
  cluster_type   <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "PSOCK" else "FORK"
  cl <- makeCluster(num_cores_to_use, type = cluster_type)
  registerDoParallel(cl)

grouped_data <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
  group_by(Selection, Gene_Number, Replicate)

unique_combinations <- grouped_data %>%
  summarize() %>%
  ungroup()

spectral_results <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(unique_combinations), .packages = c("dplyr", "stats")) %dopar% {
  sel <- unique_combinations$Selection[i]
  gene_num <- unique_combinations$Gene_Number[i]
  rep <- unique_combinations$Replicate[i]
  
  df <- AlleleFreq_dataset %>%
    filter(Selection == sel, Gene_Number == gene_num, Replicate == rep) %>%
    arrange(Generation)
  
  mean_freq_df <- df %>%
    group_by(Generation) %>%
    summarize(Mean_Frequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(Generation)
  
ts_data <- ts(mean_freq_df$Mean_Frequency, 
              start = min(mean_freq_df$Generation), frequency = 1)
  
spec_result <- spectrum(ts_data, spans = 2, plot = FALSE)
period <- 1 / spec_result$freq
  
  data.frame(
    Period = period,
    Spectrum = spec_result$spec,
    Selection = sel,
    Gene_Number = gene_num,
    Replicate = rep
  )
}

# Stop cluster
stopCluster(cl)

spectral_data <- bind_rows(spectral_results)

spectral_data <- spectral_data %>%
  filter(Period < 80)

All_models_Spec <- spectral_data %>%
  mutate(
    Facet_formula = factor(
      paste0(Gene_Number, " ", Selection),
      levels = c(
        "1 Locus Instantaneous", "10 Loci Instantaneous", "100 Loci Instantaneous",  "300 Loci Instantaneous",
        "1 Locus Simple Gradual", "10 Loci Simple Gradual", "100 Loci Simple Gradual",  "300 Loci Simple Gradual",
        "1 Locus Complex Gradual I", "10 Loci Complex Gradual I", "100 Loci Complex Gradual I" , "300 Loci Complex Gradual I" ,
        "1 Locus Complex Gradual II", "10 Loci Complex Gradual II", "100 Loci Complex Gradual II", "300 Loci Complex Gradual II"
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Period, y = Spectrum, group = Replicate, color = Replicate)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1, size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number())+
  #facet_wrap( ~ Selection + Gene_Number, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Facet_formula, scales = "free", ncol = 3, dir = "h") +
  #scale_color_viridis_d() +  # Use a discrete color palette
  labs(
    x = "Period (Generations)",
    y = "Spectral Density",
    color = "Replicate"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Spectral Density", x = "Period (Generations)",
       y = "Spectral Density")+
  theme_bw()+
  mythemes
    
# 
# ggsave("All_models_Spec.jpg", plot = All_models_Spec, dpi = 600, width = 49, height = 30, units = "in", path = "../OutputFigures.dir")

ggsave("SI_10.All_models_Spec.jpg",  plot = All_models_Spec, width = 50, height = 30, units = "in", path = "../OutputFigures.dir/SupplementalFigures.dir", limitsize = FALSE)

print(All_models_Spec)
```

## 11. Fluctuating population fixation

```{r, fig.width=30, fig.height=20, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| label: FixationRate_comparison
#| fig-cap: "SI 11. Allele-frequency dynamics and initial QTL fixation across models with fluctuating selection and/or fluctuating population size for a polygenic model of 100 loci. The top panel shows allele-frequency dynamics for 30 randomly selected initial QTL alleles across five replicates in the high-parameter regime, while the bottom panel shows the mean ± SE percentage of initial QTL alleles fixed across 30 replicates."
#| fig-pos: "H"

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(future)
library(furrr)

plot_dir <- "/home/etb68/Mylab/evogen-sims/FluctSelectionModels.dir/WritingFigures.dir/OutputFigures.dir/Amplitudes_plt.dir/PopModels"
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

target_n <- 300
target_replicates <- 1:30
target_H <- c(0.1, 0.8)
target_SD <- c(1, 4)
target_Gen <- c(10, 30)

target_replicates_for_dynamics <- 1:5
dynamics_H <- 0.8
dynamics_SD <- 4
dynamics_Gen <- 30
n_alleles_for_dynamics <- 30
max_generation_to_plot <- 2000

default_Gen_if_missing <- 30
fixation_tol <- 1e-9

n_workers <- min(32, future::availableCores())
future::plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)

model_sources <- tibble(
  Model = c(
    "Constant_Selection Instantaneous_Population",
    "Null_Selection Instantaneous_Population",
    "Instantaneous_Selection Constant_Population",
    "Instantaneous_Selection Instantaneous_Population"
  ),
  folder_path = c(
    "~/Mylab/EvoGenFP.sims/FluctPopulationModels.dir/Output.dir/ConstSelInstatPop",
    "~/Mylab/EvoGenFP.sims/FluctPopulationModels.dir/Output.dir/NeutrSelInstatPop",
    "~/Mylab/evogen-sims/FluctSelectionModels.dir/Output.dir/LinFS.dir",
    "~/Mylab/EvoGenFP.sims/FluctPopulationModels.dir/Output.dir/InstSelInstatPop"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(folder_path = path.expand(folder_path))

safe_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

clean_model_label <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_replace(" Constant Population", "\nConstant Population") %>%
    str_replace(" Instantaneous Population", "\nInstantaneous Population")
}

make_allele_id <- function(df) {
  if (all(c("Position", "Effect", "Origin") %in% names(df))) {
    df %>%
      mutate(allele_id = paste(Position, Effect, Origin, sep = "_"))
  } else if (all(c("Position", "Effect") %in% names(df))) {
    df %>%
      mutate(allele_id = paste(Position, Effect, sep = "_"))
  } else {
    df %>%
      mutate(allele_id = as.character(Position))
  }
}

format_factors <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Model = factor(Model, levels = model_sources$Model),
      Model_Label = factor(
        clean_model_label(as.character(Model)),
        levels = clean_model_label(model_sources$Model)
      ),
      H_factor = factor(H, levels = target_H),
      SD_factor = factor(SD, levels = target_SD),
      Gen_factor = factor(Gen, levels = target_Gen)
    )
}

extract_params <- function(file, Model) {
  file_name <- basename(file)
  
  tibble(
    Model = Model,
    file = file,
    file_name = file_name,
    replicate = coalesce(
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "^genome([0-9]+)_")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "genome_repl([0-9]+)_")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "^repl([0-9]+)_")[, 2])
    ),
    n = coalesce(
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "_n([0-9]+)_")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "_loci([0-9]+)_")[, 2])
    ),
    H = coalesce(
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "H([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)SD")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "_h([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)")[, 2])
    ),
    SD = coalesce(
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)(?:Gen|\\.csv)")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "_SD([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)")[, 2])
    ),
    Gen = coalesce(
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "Gen([0-9]+)")[, 2]),
      safe_num(str_match(file_name, "_Gen([0-9]+)")[, 2])
    )
  )
}

files_by_model <- model_sources %>%
  mutate(
    file = map(
      folder_path,
      ~ list.files(.x, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(file)

if (nrow(files_by_model) == 0) {
  stop("No files found. Check model_sources$folder_path.")
}

param_table_raw <- pmap_dfr(
  files_by_model %>% select(file, Model),
  extract_params
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(replicate),
    !is.na(n),
    n == target_n,
    replicate %in% target_replicates
  )

if (nrow(param_table_raw) == 0) {
  stop("No files remain after n and replicate filtering.")
}

param_table <- param_table_raw %>%
  mutate(
    is_null = str_detect(Model, "^Null_Selection"),
    Gen = if_else(is_null & is.na(Gen), default_Gen_if_missing, Gen)
  ) %>%
  split(seq_len(nrow(.))) %>%
  map_dfr(function(row_df) {
    
    row_df <- as_tibble(row_df)
    
    if (row_df$is_null) {
      
      expand_grid(
        H = if (is.na(row_df$H)) target_H else row_df$H,
        SD = if (is.na(row_df$SD)) target_SD else row_df$SD,
        Gen = row_df$Gen
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          Model = row_df$Model,
          file = row_df$file,
          file_name = row_df$file_name,
          replicate = row_df$replicate,
          n = row_df$n
        )
      
    } else {
      
      tibble(
        Model = row_df$Model,
        file = row_df$file,
        file_name = row_df$file_name,
        replicate = row_df$replicate,
        n = row_df$n,
        H = row_df$H,
        SD = row_df$SD,
        Gen = row_df$Gen
      )
    }
  }) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(H),
    !is.na(SD),
    !is.na(Gen),
    H %in% target_H,
    SD %in% target_SD,
    Gen %in% target_Gen
  ) %>%
  distinct(Model, file, file_name, replicate, n, H, SD, Gen, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  format_factors()

if (nrow(param_table) == 0) {
  stop("No files remain after parameter expansion and filtering.")
}

replicate_check <- param_table %>%
  count(Model, H, SD, Gen, name = "n_replicates") %>%
  filter(n_replicates != length(target_replicates))

if (nrow(replicate_check) > 0) {
  print(replicate_check)
  stop("Some model/parameter combinations do not have all target replicates.")
}

read_clean_allele_file <- function(file, file_name) {
  fl <- read.csv(file)
  
  if (!all(c("Generation", "Frequency", "Position") %in% names(fl))) {
    warning("Skipping file missing required columns: ", file_name)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  fl %>%
    make_allele_id() %>%
    mutate(
      Generation = safe_num(Generation),
      Frequency = safe_num(Frequency),
      allele_id = as.character(allele_id)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Generation),
      !is.na(Frequency),
      !is.na(allele_id),
      is.finite(Generation),
      is.finite(Frequency)
    )
}

calculate_fixation <- function(Model, file, file_name, replicate, n, H, SD, Gen, ...) {
  fl <- read_clean_allele_file(file, file_name)
  if (is.null(fl) || nrow(fl) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  first_generation <- min(fl$Generation)
  
  initial_alleles <- fl %>%
    filter(Generation == first_generation) %>%
    distinct(allele_id)
  
  fixed_alleles <- fl %>%
    semi_join(initial_alleles, by = "allele_id") %>%
    filter(Frequency >= 1 - fixation_tol) %>%
    distinct(allele_id)
  
  tibble(
    Model = Model,
    file_name = file_name,
    replicate = replicate,
    n = n,
    H = H,
    SD = SD,
    Gen = Gen,
    fixed_count = nrow(fixed_alleles),
    total_initial_alleles = nrow(initial_alleles),
    fixation_percent = 100 * fixed_count / total_initial_alleles
  )
}

sample_allele_dynamics <- function(Model, file, file_name, replicate, n, H, SD, Gen, ...) {
  fl <- read_clean_allele_file(file, file_name)
  if (is.null(fl) || nrow(fl) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  first_generation <- min(fl$Generation)
  
  initial_alleles <- fl %>%
    filter(Generation == first_generation) %>%
    distinct(allele_id)
  
  fl <- fl %>%
    semi_join(initial_alleles, by = "allele_id") %>%
    filter(Generation <= max_generation_to_plot)
  
  if (nrow(fl) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  set.seed(
    768678 +
      as.integer(replicate) * 1000 +
      as.integer(n) +
      as.integer(SD) +
      as.integer(Gen) +
      as.integer(H * 100)
  )
  
  sampled_alleles <- sample(
    unique(fl$allele_id),
    min(n_alleles_for_dynamics, n_distinct(fl$allele_id)),
    replace = FALSE
  )
  
  fl %>%
    filter(allele_id %in% sampled_alleles) %>%
    mutate(
      Model = Model,
      file_name = file_name,
      replicate = replicate,
      n = n,
      H = H,
      SD = SD,
      Gen = Gen
    )
}

param_table_dynamics <- param_table %>%
  filter(
    replicate %in% target_replicates_for_dynamics,
    H == dynamics_H,
    SD == dynamics_SD,
    Gen == dynamics_Gen
  )

allele_dynamics_by_replicate <- future_pmap_dfr(
  param_table_dynamics,

) %>%

print(Allele_Frequency_Dynamics_By_Replicate)

fixation_by_replicate <- future_pmap_dfr(
```
